integrity.claim_basis: Analytic all-dimensional proof using original polytope facet description and exact Euclidean normal lengths.
integrity.finite_verification: Independent numerical Chebyshev linear programs and explicit vertex equivalences; finite samples are not a universal proof.

scientific_limitations: Full-dimensional linked toric intervals only; general lattice-path delta matroid polytopes not classified.
The full incenter set is specified by inequalities; its face numbers are not determined.
Unindexed older mathematical formulations may exist.
title: A weighted-run formula for Euclidean inballs of linked symmetric snake-path polytopes
